title: Meet Spresso: shopping starts with a conversation
summary: An introduction to the AI personal-shopping assistant we're building, and why its experience should feel more helpful than a traditional storefront.
body: We're building Spresso around a simple idea: shopping shouldn't require you to open a dozen tabs just to find the right thing.
Instead of behaving like a store that sells its own inventory, Spresso is intended to help you explore products, research retailers, and organize the decisions that come before a purchase.
We want the people who use Spresso to see the product evolve: the features we're testing, the choices we're making, and what still needs work. This journal is where we'll share that process.
